caption:
The manifest lied about the weight of this crate. Then the overhead rail decided my bag was its new best friend, nearly dragging me into a high-voltage trip. My boots are currently doing their best to find traction on this oily mess. I’m standing in front of the foreman now, trying to look like I’ve been doing this for years. 😰

The foreman's eyes narrow as he scans her face.

#neotokyo #industrial #nightshift #worklife #dockingbay #citylife
